function(_z_simd_flags out)
  set(${out} -mavx2 -mfma PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
_z_simd_flags(_simd)
target_compile_options(helios_z PRIVATE ${_simd})
function(_z_use t)
  _z_simd_flags(_f)
  target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE ${_f})
endfunction()
macro(_z_simd_m out)
  set(${out} -mavx2 -mfma)
endmacro()
_z_simd_m(_simd3)
target_compile_options(helios_z PRIVATE ${_simd3})
function(_z_simd)
  set(_simd2 -mavx2 -mfma)
  return(PROPAGATE _simd2)
endfunction()
_z_simd()
target_compile_options(helios_z PRIVATE ${_simd2})
function(_z_apply t)
  target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE ${_z_flags})
endfunction()
function(_z_setup t)
  set(_z_flags -mavx2)
  _z_apply(${t})
endfunction()
_z_setup(helios_z)
function(_z_cache)
  set(_cached -mavx2 CACHE INTERNAL "")
endfunction()
target_compile_options(helios_z PRIVATE ${_cached})
function(_z_forward out)
  _z_simd_flags(${out})
endfunction()
_z_forward(_fwd)
target_compile_options(helios_z PRIVATE ${_fwd})
function(_z_plain t)
  set(_z_local -mavx2)
  target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE ${_z_quiet})
endfunction()
_z_plain(helios_z)
target_compile_options(helios_z PRIVATE ${_z_local})
_zh_flags()
target_compile_options(helios_z PRIVATE ${_zh_out})
_zh_into(_zh_var)
target_compile_options(helios_z PRIVATE ${_zh_var})
